machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

implementation.schedule: A complete 25-step FlowMatch schedule generated for 256 latent tokens; not a truncated 40-step schedule
implementation.cli: The final optional generation argument accepts 25 or 40
implementation.step_count_provenance: 25 came from the Comfy-Org Qwen-Image-2.1 workflow template. Its own note says the official pipeline uses about 40-50 Euler steps and that the template starts at 25; it is not an official Qwen recommendation.
implementation.reference_policy: Official trajectory checkpoints remain restricted to the canonical 40-step schedule

native_prompt_to_png.prompt: A blue ceramic teapot on a windowsill.
native_prompt_to_png.measurement_note: Fresh-process warm-filesystem measurements. Text paging and GPU frequency vary between runs; fixed text, startup, VAE, and PNG costs limit the end-to-end benefit relative to the denoising-loop reduction.

quality.cache_off_visual_comparison: Extremely close to the 40-step image in composition and detail; minor highlight and texture differences only
quality.cache_dit_0_24_visual_comparison: Coherent and prompt-correct, but body, handle, lid geometry, and highlights diverge more visibly from 40-step cache-off
quality.decision: Accept the community-template 25-step choice as an explicit option; preserve Qwen's 40-step recommendation as the compatibility and reproducibility default; keep 25-step Cache-DiT explicitly approximate
